description: Starter adaptive-card runbooks derived from the PowerTask Copilot Studio selector guide and enriched with MCP-backed validation, export, and recovery guidance.

runbooks.name: PowerTask: Create Blank Agent
runbooks.label: Starter
runbooks.detail: Create a new Copilot Studio agent from the Home or Agents surface and confirm the agent shell opens.
runbooks.goal: Create a blank Copilot Studio agent and verify the new agent workspace opens on the Overview surface.
steps: Open Copilot Studio Home or Agents.
Select Create blank agent.
Enter an agent description if the creation flow requests one.
Wait for the new agent shell to load.

detailInputs.agentDescription: Create a support agent grounded on website knowledge and ready for topic authoring.

notes: Use the Home card or Agents page entry point depending on the current experience.
If the conversational description box is absent, skip the typing step and validate the agent shell directly.
validationChecklist: Confirm the intended Copilot Studio environment is visible before agent creation starts.
Verify the new agent shell opens on Overview and exposes the Knowledge and Topics tabs.
Capture both browser_snapshot and browser_take_screenshot after the shell is stable.
recoveryGuidance: If the wrong environment is open, stop and switch environments before creating the agent.
If the conversational description box does not appear, skip the typing step and validate the shell directly.
If creation stalls or an error banner appears, capture browser_console_messages plus a screenshot before retrying.
exportGuidance: After validating the shell, save a screenshot such as agent-created.png for the runbook evidence bundle.
If you refined selectors interactively, export the generated history with copilotbrowser-mcp-browser_export_playwright_test.
For CI packaging, export copilotbrowser-mcp-browser_export_github_actions into .github/workflows/copilotbrowser.yml.

runbooks.name: PowerTask: Add Website Knowledge
runbooks.label: Starter
runbooks.detail: Open the Knowledge tab for an existing agent, add a website URL, confirm ownership, and submit the source.
runbooks.goal: Attach a website knowledge source to the current agent and verify the knowledge entry is accepted.
steps: Open the current agent.
Navigate to the Knowledge tab.
Enter the website URL.
Confirm ownership and add the source.
notes: This starter assumes an agent is already open in Copilot Studio.
If the ownership control uses a different accessible label, replace the checkbox selector in detail inputs.
validationChecklist: Confirm the Knowledge tab stays selected after the source is added.
Verify the exact knowledge URL is shown in the source list.
Check that no visible Error or Failed to save banner remains on screen.
recoveryGuidance: If Add stays disabled, verify the URL format and ownership confirmation state before retrying.
If the source is rejected, capture browser_snapshot, browser_take_screenshot, and browser_console_messages before changing inputs.
If the page appears stalled, refresh the page manually and reopen the Knowledge tab rather than continuing blindly.
exportGuidance: Capture a final screenshot such as knowledge-added.png once the URL is visible.
Export the interaction history to a Playwright spec if this knowledge onboarding flow will be reused.
Attach the exported workflow template when handing the smoke test to CI or another operator.

runbooks.name: PowerTask: Create Custom Topic
runbooks.label: Starter
runbooks.detail: Create a new custom topic from blank, provide name and description, and save it into the current agent.
runbooks.goal: Create a new custom topic in the current Copilot Studio agent and confirm the topic appears in the Topics list.
steps: Open the Topics tab for the current agent.
Choose Add a topic and select From blank.
Fill in topic name and description.
Save and confirm the topic is listed.

detailInputs.topicDescription: Handle website escalation requests and collect the required follow-up details.

notes: Use stable aria-label selectors where possible; only fall back to class-based selectors if the labels differ in your tenant.
If the topic editor opens in a canvas immediately, validate the save on the canvas before returning to the list.
validationChecklist: Verify the Topics tab is active before opening the Add a topic menu.
Confirm the topic name is listed after save and, when present, the Custom label is visible.
Capture a post-save snapshot or screenshot once the editor returns to a stable state.
recoveryGuidance: If Save remains disabled, capture evidence and re-check the required topic fields instead of clicking repeatedly.
If a Saving or loading banner lingers, wait for it to clear and then re-run validation before editing again.
If a save error appears, preserve console output and the current topic draft before navigating away.
exportGuidance: Store a screenshot such as topic-{topicName}-created.png after the new topic is listed.
Export the browser interaction history if you want a reusable topic-authoring regression spec.
Bundle the runbook payload plus exported workflow when sharing the topic flow with other environments.

runbooks.name: PowerTask: Add Dataverse MCP Tool
runbooks.label: Starter
runbooks.detail: Open the Tools tab, search for Dataverse MCP Server, add it to the agent, and confirm the tool is enabled.
runbooks.goal: Attach the Dataverse MCP Server tool to the current agent and confirm the tool is available in the tool list.
steps: Open the Tools tab inside the current agent.
Choose Add a tool.
Search for Dataverse MCP Server.
Add the tool to the agent and enable it if a toggle is shown.
notes: If the tenant shows a toggle after adding the tool, add a click step for div[role="switch"] or the specific enable control.
Keep the search text in detail inputs so the same starter can be reused for other tools.
validationChecklist: Verify the exact Dataverse MCP Server result appears in tool search before clicking Add to agent.
Confirm the tool remains visible in the tool list after the add flow completes.
Capture evidence if an enable switch is required so the final configured state is documented.
recoveryGuidance: If search returns no results, clear the query and retry with the exact tool name before changing anything else.
If the add dialog closes without the tool appearing, capture snapshot, screenshot, and console output before reopening it.
If a switch or consent prompt blocks completion, stop after evidence capture and resolve the prompt explicitly.
exportGuidance: Capture a screenshot such as tool-added.png after the Dataverse tool appears in the configured list.
Export a Playwright spec once the final selector path is stable enough for regression coverage.
Export the GitHub Actions template when this tool-enablement smoke test needs automated scheduling.

runbooks.name: PowerTask: Publish Agent
runbooks.label: Starter
runbooks.detail: Publish the current agent, confirm the publish dialog, wait for completion, and close the publish experience.
runbooks.goal: Publish the current Copilot Studio agent and confirm the publish flow completes without visible errors.
steps: Open the publish dialog.
Confirm the publish action.
Wait for publishing feedback and success messaging.
Close the dialog.
notes: If the tenant keeps a success dialog open, capture the success text before closing it.
If policy checks block publish, preserve the failure screenshot and console output for triage.
validationChecklist: Confirm the publish dialog opens and the final publish action is explicitly acknowledged.
Verify Publishing... disappears and no visible Error banner remains.
Capture a final screenshot once the publish flow reports success or returns to a stable state.
recoveryGuidance: If Publishing... never clears, capture snapshot, screenshot, and browser_console_messages before halting the flow.
If policy or validation banners block publish, keep the dialog open long enough to preserve evidence before closing it.
If the dialog becomes unresponsive, stop after evidence capture instead of issuing repeated publish clicks.
exportGuidance: Use a screenshot such as published-{timestamp}.png for the evidence bundle after successful publish.
Export the recorded interaction history to a Playwright test if publish verification should become a regression gate.
Export the GitHub Actions workflow to seed CI with the same publish smoke-test scaffolding.

runbooks.name: PowerTask: Validate Environment
runbooks.label: Starter
runbooks.detail: Confirm the expected Copilot Studio environment is active before editing an agent and capture baseline evidence.
runbooks.goal: Open Copilot Studio, verify the expected environment label is visible, and preserve a baseline snapshot plus screenshot before any agent edits start.
steps: Open Copilot Studio.
Wait for the expected environment name to become visible in the shell.
Capture a structured snapshot and a screenshot for the environment handoff record.
validationChecklist: Verify the intended environment name is visible before opening any specific agent.
Capture both structured and visual evidence so later failures can be tied to the correct environment.
Do not proceed to agent edits until the environment label is stable.
recoveryGuidance: If the expected environment is not visible, halt and switch environments manually before continuing.
If the shell partially loads, use snapshot plus screenshot evidence and retry navigation instead of guessing the active environment.
If the environment picker is ambiguous, stop after evidence capture and request operator confirmation.
exportGuidance: Attach environment-validation.png to the runbook handoff so later task evidence can be correlated.
Export the interaction history to a Playwright spec if environment validation should run before every CI smoke test.
Export the GitHub Actions workflow when this baseline environment check should be automated.
notes: The pasted reference emphasized environment confirmation as a critical guardrail before agent changes.
This repo wait tool supports time, text, and textGone checks only, so environment validation is expressed as text visibility.

runbooks.name: PowerTask: Test Agent Chat
runbooks.label: Starter
runbooks.detail: Send a smoke-test message to the current agent chat surface and capture the initial response state.
runbooks.goal: Enter a test message into the active agent chat, wait briefly for a response, and preserve evidence of the resulting conversation state.
steps: Open the current agent test or chat surface.
Enter a smoke-test prompt and send it.
Wait for the chat surface to update, then capture evidence.

detailInputs.testMessage: Hello, confirm that you can answer a support request.

validationChecklist: Confirm the test message appears in the conversation transcript.
Check that no visible Error banner appears after send.
Capture a snapshot and screenshot of the resulting chat state, even if the reply is still streaming.
recoveryGuidance: If Send stays disabled, verify the correct chat input selector and preserve evidence before retrying.
If the chat surface does not update after the wait, capture browser_console_messages before sending the prompt again.
If the wrong tab is open, stop and navigate back to the agent test surface rather than typing into an unknown field.
exportGuidance: Use agent-chat-smoke.png as the initial evidence artifact for chat validation.
Export the recorded history to a Playwright test when the smoke prompt and selectors stabilize.
Export the GitHub Actions workflow when this chat smoke test should run unattended.
notes: This starter intentionally uses a short fixed wait because the current wait tool does not support waiting on selectors.
If your tenant uses a different chat input control, update the detail input selectors before sending.

runbooks.name: PowerTask: Capture Failure Evidence
runbooks.label: Starter
runbooks.detail: Capture snapshot, screenshot, and console evidence when a PowerTask flow fails or blocks on an unexpected banner.
runbooks.goal: Preserve the current browser state, a visual screenshot, and error-level console messages before anyone retries or refreshes a failed flow.
steps: Leave the failing UI in place without additional clicks.
Capture a full browser snapshot.
Capture a screenshot and collect error-level console output for triage.
validationChecklist: Capture evidence before any refresh, retry, or back navigation is attempted.
Ensure both the screenshot artifact and console log are saved with the incident record.
Leave the failing page open until another operator confirms evidence collection is complete.
recoveryGuidance: After evidence capture, decide whether to retry, refresh, or back out based on the visible banner and console log.
If the page is clearly in the wrong state, use the evidence bundle to hand off before reloading anything.
Do not keep clicking the same action after evidence capture; halt and triage first.
exportGuidance: Keep error-detected.png and failure-console.log together with the snapshot text for the incident bundle.
If you reproduce the same issue interactively, export the sequence to a Playwright spec for regression coverage.
Export the GitHub Actions template if the failure investigation should be reproduced in CI.
notes: This starter translates the paste reference recovery guidance into repo-supported tools only.
Use this runbook before any manual refresh or retry so the original failure state is preserved.
